name: actual native constructor and inherited processOptions prove same-instance literal argv launch
purpose: Causal new-feature positive: real source API shape, not the toy PortableInvocation. No actual child is launched.

name: renamed import preserves the same actual native API authority
purpose: Lexical import identity, not local class spelling, must own the proof.

name: plain object processOptions method cannot confer native authority
source:
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; const invocation = { executable: process.execPath, args: ['worker.js'], processOptions() { return {}; } };
spawn(invocation.executable, invocation.args, { ...invocation.processOptions(), shell: false });
purpose: Matching field/method names are not a validated invocation instance.

name: native-named foreign class cannot confer native authority
purpose: A local class name is not a constructor/parent contract.

name: overridden foreign processOptions method cannot inherit native authority
purpose: A subtype may not replace the validated option producer.

name: options from a different native instance do not match the executable and argv instance
purpose: Executable, argv and option producer must share the same lexical validated instance.

name: foreign options spread stays unresolved even beside a real invocation
shell true remains a launch violation
purpose: Known constructor does not authorize a shell override.

name: uid injection remains a platform authority violation
purpose: Safe processOptions does not erase additional launch authority.
